label: UniFi Dream Router 7
description: UniFi Dream Router 7 (UDR7) - 4x 2.5G RJ45 (1 PoE) + 1x 10G SFP+ (10G/1G). WiFi 6/7; 26 W max.

poe.note: 15.4 W, the whole published budget: the tech-spec table lists "2.5 GbE RJ45 = 4 (1 PoE)" and, under Hardware, "PoE Budget = 15.4W", "PoE = 15.4W", "Voltage Range PoE Mode = 44-57V" (read 2026-11-19). One 802.3af port at its 15.4 W maximum exactly uses the budget, which is why eth0 is the only poeOut port modelled. This model has no datasheet in its documents list - the product page names only https://ui.com/qig/udr7 (InstallationGuide) - so the rendered spec table is the vendor source.
